headquarters: Johannesburg, South Africa (registered office: London, United Kingdom)

mines.mine_notes: Underground mines: Fairview (40,804 oz), Sheba and Consort (27,745 oz combined). High-grade operation, mining since 1880s; workforce restructuring completed May 2025 (~20% workforce reduction). 331,964 t milled @ recovered grade 6.4 g/t. Cash cost not disclosed per mine.

Surface tailings retreatment (Barberton); completed June 2013. 725,535 t processed @ 0.7 g/t; recovery 42.1%. Lowest-cost operation in group. Remaining LoM 6 years incl. reprocessing of Bramber dormant TSF.

Surface tailings retreatment (Evander; Kinross, Leslie/Bracken, Winkelhaak TSFs); commissioned 2018; flagship tailings operation, one of Southern Africa's lowest-cost gold mines. 14,747,232 t processed @ 0.1 g/t.

Underground: 8 Shaft pillar extraction + development of 24/25/26 Level high-grade areas; 8 Shaft pillar mining commenced. 122,208 t milled @ 6.8 g/t. Egoli project permitting. 8.75 MW solar plant at Evander commissioned; phase 2 solar planned.
Gold-bearing material purchased from third parties, leveraging excess Evander plant capacity. 34,411 t @ 1.0 g/t. Reserves/resources not reported.

Surface tailings retreatment (Mogale Cluster and Soweto Cluster TSFs; Mogale Gold/MSC acquisitions); commissioned Oct 2024 ahead of schedule/under budget; steady-state Dec 2024. 7,509,525 t processed @ 0.1 g/t. 20 MW solar plant update ongoing.
Tennant Creek, Australia (acquired FY25); Nobles Gold CIL plant constructed, first gold pour FY25. Processes surface + underground material. 85,316 t @ 0.6 g/t (commissioning year).

notes: Fiscal year ends 30 June. FY2025 group: gold sold 196,527 oz (up 5.6%); AISC US$1,600/oz (FY24: $1,354); cash costs US$1,426/oz; average realised gold price US$2,735/oz; revenue US$540.0M (gold US$538.6M + silver US$1.0M). Low-cost surface retreatment operations produced 51% of group gold (FY24: 41%). Growth capex US$156.3M, sustaining capex US$11.7M. Group unhedged from July 2025. Dual primary listing JSE:AIM (AIM: PAF, JSE: PAN); ADR: PAFRY. FY26 guidance: 275,000–292,000 oz. Mineral reserve/resource statement per SAMREC; life-of-mine: Barberton 23 yrs, BTRP 6, Elikhulu 9, Evander 12, MTR 19, Tennant 8. Sudan operations on care and maintenance (not listed).
